title: Cute but poor quality
text: Cute but poor quality. It's hard to get the confetti to stick to the sides. It mostly just falls to the bottom. Plus I had 5 balloons with holes near the mouth piece that wouldn't hold air. And 3 popped when I was inflating them. Cute idea. Poor quality. I would probably pick regular balloons next time.

product_metadata.title: Linking Confetti Balloons, Solid, Rainbow Balloons, Party, Garland, Birthday Party Set, Balloon Decorations (Rainbow)
features: These confetti balloons will be the life of the party at your next celebration. The balloon garland creates a big impact in any space. Hang from the ceilings, walls or drape over any table. Mix and layer colors to match a theme or for a fun look.
Perfect for any party, event or celebration!
Set includes 50 6” balloons pre-filled with confetti. We recommend using a handheld balloon pump. Easy to blow up and link together.

Warning: CHOKING HAZARD. Children under 8 years can choke or suffocate on uninflated or broken balloons. Adult supervision required. Keep uninflated balloons from children. Discard broken balloons as once.
description: These linking confetti balloons are so unique and fun for every event. Choose the rainbow mix or 12 different solid colors. Balloons come pre-filled to make it super easy for you. The perfect decorations for all events: birthdays, graduation, weddings, baby shower, first birthday cake smash or use as a photoshoot backdrop. Mix light blue and light pink for the perfect gender reveal party or the rainbow mix would work for several different parties.
